items.question: Where should the purified support be placed in the mandala rite?
premises: The support is purified by the heart.
The support is placed on the mandala.
Placement follows the prior triangular arrangement.
items.inference: Therefore the purified support rests atop the mandala.
uncertainties: hṛdā may mean by heart or with water.
items.plain_english: Having purified the support with the heart, one should place it on the mandala.
